timing: Before any new short-prompt response generation; after initial paired hard-case responses and first reviews.
purpose: Check the specific risk that expanded guidance inflates or overformats a simple explanation. These are known regression cases, separate from the 60 hard prompts.
conditions: Both frozen v4 and the selected final bundle, using the same six-case order and fresh-context transport. The earlier addendum planned candidate-only short checks; a matched current baseline avoids relying on a historical run under different surrounding conditions.
metrics: Same six semantic dimensions. Report words and Unicode characters separately; word counting does not segment Chinese and includes code/numbers. Length is a secondary descriptive measure, not a substitute for completeness or readability.

criterion_clarification.timing: Before any new short-prompt response generation.
criterion_clarification.change: The legacy criterion discouraged implying any execution. The new criterion permits a truthful execution claim when the responder actually runs the snippet; the user did not forbid safe execution. No earlier N04 response was used to choose this clarification.
